privacy_note: Font scale, line spacing and high contrast are local presentation preferences.
Quick-look terms are derived at render time from the public story snapshot.
Only story IDs are stored in the browser-local versioned state key.
Section order and update time stay on the reader device and are never exported.
Self-contained HTML and JSON contain public source-scoped summaries only; no reading state is embedded.
Text size and note visibility for storyteller mode are stored only in the existing browser-local reader key.
